---
title: "Generate migrations that drop tables in an order D1 accepts"
description: "Drop when the pinned release generates SQLite migrations that drop each table before the tables it references."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

On D1, payload migrate:down on a generated migration that created a
collection with versions stops with "no such table: main.pages" and leaves
the database half migrated. D1 runs a migration without a transaction, so the
"Rolling back" in the log rolls nothing back, and the next migrate or
migrate:down fails on the tables that are already gone.

drizzle-kit writes DROP TABLE statements in the order of the snapshot the
migration starts from, and Payload builds a collection's table before its
version tables. D1 always enforces foreign keys and ignores PRAGMA
foreign_keys = OFF. Dropping a table fails when another table that references
it also references a table that is already dropped, as _pages_v_rels does for
_pages_v and pages, and PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys = on doesn't prevent that.

The D1 adapter's drizzle-kit now puts the snapshot in drop order first, so a
generated migration drops each table before the tables it references. The
fix has to be in the generated SQL: a migration is code that the adapter runs
statement by statement, and no PRAGMA lets D1 drop the tables in the old
order. Migrations generated before this change keep their order. The libSQL
adapter keeps drizzle-kit's order.

- **Patch:** `d1-migration-drop-order`, committed as `fix(db-d1-sqlite): generate migrations that drop tables in an order D1 accepts`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/db-d1-sqlite/src/requireDrizzleKit.spec.ts; e2e suite (e2e/scripts/prepare.ts runs migrate:down on D1)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0008-fix-db-d1-sqlite-generate-migrations-that-drop-table.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0008-fix-db-d1-sqlite-generate-migrations-that-drop-table.patch)
